coaching.headline: Kaelen ran the whole damn game from support with ten kills and one death, and every Fangtooth and Prime went to the enemy.

flags.text: No ally finished a tenacity item against Kaelen's stun and two roots.
Genesis Core and the third Fangtooth went to the enemy with no ally death in the prior minute.
Enemy took the last six kills, three inside the allied base; two more inhibitors and the Core fell.
Shinbi still led the game with 21768 hero damage despite five deaths.

focus.title: Build for Kaelen, fight after Frostfall
focus.action: Draft a second physical threat so one magic-resist item cannot blunt most damage; carry, jungler and mid build tenacity into Kaelen, and all five group for Fangtooth and Prime after Frostfall.

5.3.call: Lost 0-2: Sparrow killed Narbash on the duo lane, then Kaelen killed Aurora at the Fangtooth pit seconds after Scarlett took Fangtooth. After a duo-lane death that close to Fangtooth, concede the pit.

23.2.call: Won 2-0 as Skylar killed Greystone then Sparrow on the offlane, but between the two kills Sparrow destroyed the allied offlane inner tower and Renna took Primal Fangtooth. After the next won fight, push the nearest enemy tower.

24.8.call: Lost 0-2 shortly after Skylar and Argus fell: Scarlett killed Aurora on the offlane and Renna killed Shinbi on mid, and Greystone then destroyed the offlane inhibitor. After two allied deaths, defend the inhibitors together.

8e623bdc-66df-468c-b715-db2be16140b4: Zero kills, six deaths: a shit night. Two deaths to Scarlett came outside any detected fight, on the offlane in the enemy half; before crossing there, ping a laner.
Three deaths went to Kaelen. When Frostfall starts channeling, move out of the landing center and leave the Rimestorm; Unbroken Will, Forticus or Vanguardian adds tenacity.
a2403b1e-8cc4-4ae3-9ab5-29407805693e: First blood went to Greystone in the enemy half of the offlane, outside any detected fight. Before the first Fangtooth, trade only from the allied half.
The death to Sparrow outside any detected fight came shortly before Sparrow destroyed the allied offlane inner tower. With the offlane outer down, call for help before trading.
Farm sat at 6 CS per minute against an 8.3 norm. When the lane goes quiet, last-hit the full wave before leaving lane.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Ran the vision: 10 wards to the enemy support's 3, with 12871 healing. Keep that standard, and before each Fangtooth put a ward on the pit approach.
Two deaths to Sparrow on the duo lane before minute ten. Until Truesilver Bracelet lands, give ground whenever Sparrow and Kaelen show together.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Every death went to Kaelen. Against Kaelen, step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root, and finish Equinox for tenacity.
Hero damage ran at 464 per minute against a 715 norm. In grouped fights, fire Atomiser into the lockdown once Cryoseism and Thunk have landed.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Four kills, the team's most, including the game's only kill on Kaelen, seconds after Skylar's death on the duo lane. Repeat that rotation whenever Kaelen commits to the duo lane.
Three deaths to Kaelen, the last inside the allied base. Stay off Rimeglass when Kaelen engages, and add World Breaker for tenacity against the roots.

matchup: Scarlett, the jungle opponent, killed this jungler three times and never died to this jungler.
Scarlett took 218 jungle minions, 105 from the allied jungle, against 118 here.
build: Spirit Of Amir then Magnify followed the 58.7% core; Tainted Scepter, the core's third item, never came.
Tainted Guard finished after the final death here, so no recorded fight tested the armor or the healing cut.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage that grows with units killed; Cull the Weak adds damage to minions and monsters.
Iron Will heals off basic attack damage, double on crits; this build carried no crit chance.
Vesh, Lotus, Idrisil and Xyris are a toss-up in this jungle field; Vesh has the best odds.
augment: Frozen Fury gives attack speed while Frost Storm is active, growing with hero level.
Frozen Fury ranks third of three here; Hypothermia and Glacial Thorns are the toss-up lead, Hypothermia with the best odds.
crest: Typhoon stacks attack speed on basic attack hits and dashes a short distance at full stacks.
Winter's Fury and Typhoon are the toss-up for the lead in this jungle field; Winter's Fury has the best odds.
improvement: Lane record into Scarlett: 52% over 228 games. Tainted Scepter third cuts healing on magical hits, losing Tainted Guard's armor.
Hypothermia over Frozen Fury adds armor shred and an attack-speed slow on Boreal Sweep, giving up Frost Storm attack speed.
Furor in place of Iron Will forms the best Xyris pair with Cull the Weak.

matchup: Greystone, the lane opponent, scored two kills here including first blood and never died to this laner.
Greystone mitigated 40848 damage, the most in the game, and healed 13031.
build: The 65.6% core runs Orb Of Growth, Tainted Scepter, Magnify; Golem's Gift took the first slot instead.
Golem's Gift loses Stone Skin stacks on physical hero damage, and 17163 of 21633 hero damage taken here was physical.
Tainted Scepter cuts the target's healing on magical damage; finished after the allied offlane outer fell.
eternal: Xyris adds damage that grows with units killed; Furor grants attack speed on entering hero combat.
Aion is clearly the best Eternal in this offlane field; Xyris has too few games to lead.
Furor with Cull the Weak is the best Xyris pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Crescendo makes the last basic attack in the chain deal bonus magical damage.
Crescendo leans ahead of Encore and Allegro in this offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Tempest's Overcharge active damages up to three nearby heroes each second and heals off the damage.
Soulbearer leans ahead in this offlane field; Tempest ranks third among crests with enough games.
improvement: Lane record into Greystone: 51% over 391 games. Orb Of Growth first heals on ability casts, losing Golem's Gift's armor.
Aion over Xyris is the field-backed swap: mana and gold from spells, giving up kill-scaling damage.
Soulbearer over Tempest trades area damage for a shield, magical lifesteal and speed.

matchup: The duo faced Sparrow and Kaelen; the allied duo died three times before minute ten, the enemy duo zero.
Kaelen's damage to heroes split 12910 physical and 6451 true.
build: Truesilver Bracelet then Crystal Tear followed the 65% core; Dynamo replaced Everbloom as the third item.
Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take more damage briefly, so each Thunk stun sets up follow-up damage.
Truesilver Bracelet shields on ultimate cast and makes the holder CC immune while the shield holds.
eternal: Exarch gives healed or shielded targets attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage.
Exarch leans ahead in this support field. Sound keep.
Preservation with Delayed Fate is the best Exarch pair; Illumination with Fervour sits outside the most-played pairs.
augment: Thonk drops the drumstick on an enemy hit; picking the drumstick up refunds part of Thunk's cooldown and mana.
Thonk and War Anthem are a toss-up in this support field; Thonk has the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush gives nearby allies a speed burst and slow immunity.
Sanctification leans ahead in this support field; Leafsong ranks third of three crests with enough games.
improvement: Into Kaelen the field buys Forticus 21% of the time against a usual 10%, winning 56%; not built here.
Sanctification over Leafsong trades slow immunity for a team shield that grants tenacity while the shield holds.

matchup: Sparrow out-farmed this lane: 15879 gold and 216 lane minions against 10342 and 208.
Sparrow destroyed the allied duo outer tower, the offlane inner tower and the mid inhibitor.
build: Plasma Blade, Vanquisher, Imperator is the most-played core into Sparrow, 50.5% over 93 games, built in that order.
Imperator finished after the won fight, so the kills on Greystone and Sparrow came on Plasma Blade and Vanquisher.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold; Imperator makes critical strikes hit harder.
eternal: Iron Will suits this crit build: Plasma Blade, Vanquisher and Imperator add crit chance, and crits double the healing.
Xyris and Demiurge are the toss-up in this carry field; Xyris has the best odds. Sound keep.
augment: Assault MK-II lengthens the Air Assault hover and adds a missile with each attack.
Assault MK-II leans ahead of Plasma Barrage in this carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit; a hero kill soon after allows a recast.
Pacifier is clearly the best crest in this carry field. Sound keep.
improvement: Into Sparrow the lane record is 48.7% over 517 games; the most-played core was built, so no core change is proven.
Bone Collector over Cull the Weak forms the best Xyris pair with Iron Will, adding crit chance after enough unit kills.

matchup: Renna, the lane opponent, died twice to this mid and scored one kill back on the offlane.
Magical damage made up 10242 of the 18181 hero damage taken here.
build: Azure Core, Entropy, Wraith Leggings is the most-played core into Renna, 56.9% over 123 games, built in that order.
Entropy adds damage on ability hits; Wraith Leggings adds magical damage against heroes below a health threshold.
eternal: Vesh repeats part of ability damage on heroes as damage over time; Mind Rot adds a share of current health.
Aion and Vesh are the toss-up in this midlane field; Aion has the best odds.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator's beams infinite range, faster travel and longer slows.
Infinite Obliteration and Arcane Engine are the toss-up in this midlane field; Infinite Obliteration has the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device active puts the holder in Stasis.
Soulbearer is clearly the best crest in this midlane field; Epoch is the only other crest with enough games.
improvement: Into Renna the lane record is 50% over 431 games; the most-played core was built, so no core change is proven.
Soulbearer over Epoch is the field-backed swap: shield, magical lifesteal and speed, giving up the Stasis escape.

threats: Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
ourKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
ourKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes through the target → Line Tempo wolf → Circle Rhythm for shield and speed → All-Kill! once Track is maxed
ourKits.winCondition: hit heroes with abilities to max Track, then cast All-Kill! to drop a wolf pack on every hero she recently damaged
ourKits.passive: Biting Melody adds magical damage on-hit; every few seconds an empowered basic applies Track and restores mana
ourKits.playWith: teammates who engage or slow so she can dash in and land every ability for Track
ourKits.playAgainst: All-Kill! only works once she has stacked Track, so do not trade abilities with her for free; fight after Rushing Beat charges are spent, burst through Circle Rhythm's shield, and buy magical armor if she gets ahead

ourKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
ourKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
ourKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
ourKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
ourKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
ourKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
ourKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

enemyKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
enemyKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
enemyKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
enemyKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
enemyKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
enemyKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 26 minutes, fewer deaths than about 84% of Kaelen support players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Frostfall at top rank: 90s base, about 66.7s by the end (26% shorter) from 35 ability haste: Basilisk 20, Vyzar Carapace 15.
Kaelen dealt 19,450 hero damage, 22% of their team's, with +105 physical power from items.
Sustain: Vyzar Carapace: Deals 60-170 Damage, based on Level. Gain a 50 (+12%) Shield for 3s.; 3,063 healing recorded.
Toughness: +950 health; took 29,862 damage, mitigated 24,388, died 1 times.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Basilisk, Aegis Of Agawar, Vyzar Carapace. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Kaelen killed built physical armor (Aurora). We killed Kaelen 1 time.
Copy it? Too few Kaelen support games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
